strings.s0149: wl-grid uses CSS Grid: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, var(--wl-layout-grid-min)), 1fr)). The default minimum column width is 240 px; column count depends on the container's own width.

strings.s0153: Preserve DOM order when adapting layout. minmax(0, 1fr), min-width: 0 and wrapping long text prevent overflow; place wide tables in a named scrollable region.
strings.s0154: z-index works within a stacking context. Use a --wl-layer-* level, limit local composition with wl-isolate, and check whether ancestors introduce transform, opacity or isolation.
strings.s0156: Four wl-container variants: a constrained page, a narrow reading column, fluid with a gutter, and edge-to-edge full. Bars show side spacing.
strings.s0158: The basic wl-grid chooses how many equal columns fit with a --wl-layout-grid-min minimum. Resize the window: cards rearrange without JavaScript or media queries.
